In the article {{Blog|holocron|13|Major Character Birth Years}}, Leland Chee established that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] started on 3:4:14 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]] (on the basis of a 12-month calendar). The comics [[Star Wars: Darth Maul (2000)|''Star Wars: Darth Maul'']] set its story 6 months before the Invasion of Naboo. The events of ''Star Wars: Darth Maul'' can therefore be dated in 2:10 GrS. Per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]], 2:10 can be placed in the second half of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<noinclude>
